# SmartTech Australia

> SmartTech Australia delivers innovative mining and industrial technology solutions including on-board weighing systems, software platforms, and safety equipment across Australia.

SmartTech Australia is a leading provider of smart technology solutions for the mining, civil construction, and industrial sectors. The company specializes in LOADRITE weighing systems, InsightHQ fleet management software, and integrated safety solutions, with office locations across Queensland, NSW, NT, and ACT.

## Key Topics

- LOADRITE On-Board Weighing Systems
- InsightHQ Fleet Management
- Legal for Trade Scales
- Mining Safety Solutions
- Correct AI Video Analytics
- XWatch Excavator Safety
- Wireless Mesh Networks
- Lubrication Systems
- Virtual Superintendent Software
- Cabin Air Filtration
- Waste Management Scales
- Australia-Wide Compliance
- 24/7 Technical Support
- Civil Construction Technology
- Industrial Equipment

## Core Solutions & Products

- [On-Board Weighing Systems](https://smarttechaustralia.com.au/solutions/on-board-weighing-systems): LOADRITE on-board weighing systems for loaders, excavators, and haul trucks.
- [Software Solutions](https://smarttechaustralia.com.au/solutions/software-solutions): Software solutions including Virtual Superintendent, InsightHQ, and Smart Haul.
- [Legal for Trade Scales](https://smarttechaustralia.com.au/legal-for-trade): NMI-certified Legal for Trade scales including LOADRITE L2180 weighing systems.
- [Waste Management Solutions](https://smarttechaustralia.com.au/solutions/loadrite-waste-solutions): LOADRITE E2750 waste management scales with InsightHQ tracking integration.
- [Lubrication Systems](https://smarttechaustralia.com.au/lubrication-systems): Lincoln lubrication systems including Centromatic and Quicklub products.
- [Wireless Network Solutions](https://smarttechaustralia.com.au/solutions/wireless-networks): Rajant Kinetic Mesh wireless networks for underground mining operations.

## Safety & Compliance Solutions

- [Correct AI Safety Solution](https://smarttechaustralia.com.au/solutions/safety-solutions/correct-ai): Correct AI video analytics for real-time hazard detection and compliance.
- [XWatch Excavator Safety Systems](https://smarttechaustralia.com.au/solutions/safety-solutions/xwatch-safety): XWatch excavator safety systems with height, slew, and load limiters.
- [Cabin Air Filtration & Safety](https://smarttechaustralia.com.au/cabin-air-filtration-safety-australia): BMair ISO 23875 compliant HEPA filtration for operator cabin air safety.

## Specialized Systems

- [Dual Line Lubrication Systems](https://smarttechaustralia.com.au/lubrication-systems/dual-line): Lincoln dual line high-pressure lubrication for heavy mining machinery.
- [Quicklub Automatic Lubrication](https://smarttechaustralia.com.au/lubrication-systems/quicklub): Lincoln Quicklub automatic centralized lubrication for equipment maintenance.
